discussion.author: cyjin-yl
discussion.body:
Release intake at `1d033ee095f702af020b8f3ce48127c0d399a2bd`. This change spans 565 files and introduces new public Brutalist Drawer parts, new examples and experimental-family documentation. The repository is in the repair-only period defined in the [0.3 release plan](https://github.com/Proto-UI/Proto-UI/blob/9831f4209392588c5a7a02dfda3da105460b1581/internal/governance/release-0.3-plan.md#red-light-and-recovery-rules). The current regression baseline still has unresolved failures.

This feature wave remains open outside the repair integration queue. A separately identified fix for an existing 0.3 regression can proceed with its failing case and bounded scope. Bootstrap 2.3.2 and Liquid Glass remain experimental. The two-successive-cycle recovery condition and the November 27 feature freeze still apply.
